##### Project general facts

Trump International Resort is an exclusive luxury development featuring meticulously designed villas and apartments situated 130 metres above sea level. The residences offer direct sea views and are designed to provide a sophisticated and serene living experience. The project combines luxury, privacy, and carefully considered details, creating an exclusive residential environment overlooking the coast.

The development offers a range of amenities designed around a premium resort lifestyle. In addition to the villas and apartments, the hotel features unique cliff-hanging suites with private pools and panoramic views of the horizon. Located alongside a Championship Golf Course, the project also includes an exclusive members-only club with a full social calendar and world-class amenities tailored to the golfing lifestyle.

The villas and apartments are fully finished using high-quality modern materials and feature equipped kitchens. All residences are fully furnished and equipped to European standards, including furniture, dishes, essential items, and household appliances such as washing machines. The cliff-hanging suites additionally feature king-sized beds with premium linens and spa-like en-suite bathrooms with modern fixtures, providing a high level of comfort for both short- and long-term stays.

##### Location description and benefits

Yiti is a picturesque coastal area in Oman located a short distance from Muscat. Known for its pristine beaches, dramatic rocky cliffs, and clear turquoise waters, the area offers a tranquil environment surrounded by rugged mountains. Its natural setting provides opportunities for outdoor activities such as hiking, swimming, and picnicking.

Yiti is developing as a destination for luxury tourism, with plans for high-end resorts and residential communities aimed at attracting both local and international visitors. Yiti Beach is one of the area's key attractions, offering soft sands and a peaceful environment away from busier tourist destinations.

The area's proximity to Muscat provides convenient access to the capital while allowing Yiti to maintain a more secluded atmosphere. The route to the area offers scenic views of the coastline and mountains, while the ongoing development of tourism infrastructure is expected to further enhance its role as a destination in Oman while maintaining its natural character and ecological significance.
